 Writ petition (civil) praying inter alia that in the circumstances
 stated in the affidavit filed along with the Wp(C) the High Court be
 pleased to issue an interim order directing the 1st respondent to disburse
 the compensation for the acquired land of the petitioner within time frame
 fixed by this Hon'ble Court, pending disposal of this Writ Petition.

This petition coming on for orders upon perusing the petition and
 the affidavit filed in support of Wp(C) and upon hearing the arguments of
 M/S.K.I.Sageer & Muhammed Yasil, Advocates for the petitioner, Government
 Pleader for respondents 1 & 2 and of Central Government Standing Counsel
 for the respondents 3 & 4, the court passed the following:
 Order

The learned Government Pleader shall get specific instruction on the 2nd respondent and the learned Standing Counsel for the 3rd respondent also get instructions as to the reason why the amount awarded has not been disbursed to the petitioner.
